task: Add an optional max_length argument to textkit.slug.slugify. When it is set, the slug must be at most max_length characters, must not end with a hyphen, and should cut at a hyphen (a word boundary) when that keeps at least one word. If the first word alone is longer than max_length, cut that word at max_length. Leave the current behavior unchanged when max_length is not given. Raise ValueError when max_length is less than 1.
